name: Fig (Anjeer)
feederNote: Fruiting ke time potassium aur organic nutrition ki demand barh jati hai.
karachiNotes: Karachi ka warm climate fig ke liye suitable hai.
Young plants ko pehle saal peak afternoon heat se light protection dein.
Monsoon humidity me fig rust ka risk barh sakta hai, is liye air circulation maintain rakhein.
care: Full sun: 6-8+ hours direct sunlight.
Well-draining soil use karein; waterlogging avoid karein.
Water tab dein jab top 2-3 inch soil dry ho.
Monthly compost light dose helpful hai.
Fruiting phase me potassium-rich organic feeding useful hoti hai.
Mulch moisture ko stable rakhta hai.
pruning: Dead, weak, crossing branches remove karein.
Center ko open rakhein taake airflow improve ho.
Height control ke liye yearly pruning karein.
Base se nikalne wale suckers remove karein.

fruitInfo.dormantSeason: December-January in Karachi; sometimes early February if winter stays longer.
fruitInfo.fruitingSeason: May-July main crop; some varieties can continue into August-September.

methods.name: Hardwood Cutting
methods.note: January-February dormant cuttings ka success rate behtar hota hai.

methods.name: Semi-hardwood Cutting
methods.note: July-August me possible hai, moisture stable rakhein.

methods.name: Seeds
methods.note: True-to-type plant ke liye recommend nahi.

notes: July me Karachi me air layering achi chal sakti hai, medium moist rehna chahiye.
July me semi-hardwood cuttings possible hain, lekin dormant hardwood cuttings ka success aam tor par zyada hota hai.

name: Tomato
care: Full sun: 6-8 hours.
Deep watering karein, leaves ko wet na rakhein.
Stake/cage use karein taake plant upright rahe.
Compost plus balanced organic feeding regular rakhein.
Mulching soil moisture aur splash-borne disease risk control karti hai.
pruning: Lower yellow leaves remove karein.
Indeterminate tomatoes me extra suckers control karein.
Airflow ke liye crowded foliage thin karein.

name: Mint
care: Morning sun with afternoon shade works well in Karachi heat.
Soil consistently moist rakhein, soggy nahi.
Container me grow karein kyunki mint spread karta hai.
Light compost feeding enough hoti hai.
pruning: Regular tip harvesting se bushy growth aati hai.
Flower spikes remove karein for better leaves.
Leggy stems ko cut back karein.

name: Aloe Vera
care: Bright light pasand hai, harsh summer afternoon sun se bachayein.
Cactus/succulent well-draining mix use karein.
Water only after soil dries fully.
Overwatering root rot ka main reason hai.
pruning: Damaged outer leaves base se remove karein.
Offsets/pups ko separate kar ke new plants banayein.

succulentInfo.wateringRule: Dry soil cycle follow karein; saucer me standing water na rahe.
succulentInfo.sunStressNote: Brown tips heat, salt buildup, ya irregular watering se aa sakte hain.

name: Monstera Deliciosa
care: Bright indirect light best hai.
Top 1-2 inch soil dry ho to water dein.
Chunky aroid mix use karein.
Moss pole/support mature leaf size improve karta hai.
pruning: Yellow/damaged leaves remove karein.
Long vines ko node ke upar cut karein.
Stem cuttings node ke saath propagate karein.

name: Marigold
care: Full sun me best flowering hoti hai.
Well-draining soil use karein.
Over-fertilizing se leaves zyada aur flowers kam ho sakte hain.
Spent flowers remove karein.
pruning: Pinching se branching improve hoti hai.
Deadheading se flowering continue rehti hai.

name: Neem
care: Full sun and heat tolerant.
Deep but infrequent watering after establishment.
Well-draining soil zaroori hai.
Container me long-term root restriction ho sakti hai.
pruning: Young tree ko single leader shape dein.
Dead/crossing branches remove karein.
Hard pruning avoid karein unless needed.
